# Interfaces

Complete reference of all TypeScript interfaces, types, and union types exported by <code>@agent-smith/types</code>. All signatures are extracted directly from the source code in <code>packages/types/src/</code>.

## Agent Interfaces

### AgentSettings

Settings for an agent configuration, defining inference parameters and backend selection.

```typescript
interface AgentSettings {
    model?: string;
    backend?: string;
    max_tokens?: number;
    top_k?: number;
    top_p?: number;
    min_p?: number;
    temperature?: number;
    repeat_penalty?: number;
    presence_penalty?: number;
    frequency_penalty?: number;
    chat_template_kwargs?: Record<string, any>;
    props?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| <code>model</code> | <code>string \| undefined</code> | The model to use for the agent |
| <code>backend</code> | <code>string \| undefined</code> | The backend to use for inference |
| <code>max_tokens</code> | <code>number \| undefined</code> | Maximum number of tokens to generate |
| <code>top_k</code> | <code>number \| undefined</code> | Top-k sampling parameter |
| <code>top_p</code> | <code>number \| undefined</code> | Top-p (nucleus) sampling parameter |
| <code>min_p</code> | <code>number \| undefined</code> | Minimum probability for nucleus sampling |
| <code>temperature</code> | <code>number \| undefined</code> | Sampling temperature |
| <code>repeat_penalty</code> | <code>number \| undefined</code> | Penalty for repeated tokens |
| <code>presence_penalty</code> | <code>number \| undefined</code> | Penalty for token presence |
| <code>frequency_penalty</code> | <code>number \| undefined</code> | Repeat alpha frequency penalty |

### AgentSpec

Agent definition structure representing a YAML agent specification.

```typescript
interface AgentSpec {
    name: string;
    prompt: string;
    description: string;
    model: string;
    backend?: string;
    template?: TemplateSpec;
    inferParams?: InferenceParams;
    models?: Array<string>;
    shots?: Array<HistoryTurn>;
    variables?: AgentVariables;
    tools?: Array<ToolSpec>;
    toolsList?: Array<string>;
    type?: string;
    category?: string;
    mcp?: McpServerSpec;
    skills?: Array<string>;
    workflow?: AgentWorkflow;
}
```

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| <code>name</code> | <code>string</code> | The name of the agent (required) |
| <code>prompt</code> | <code>string</code> | The system prompt for the agent (required) |
| <code>description</code> | <code>string</code> | Human-readable description (required) |
| <code>model</code> | <code>string</code> | Default model to use (required) |
| <code>backend</code> | <code>string \| undefined</code> | Inference backend override |
| <code>template</code> | <code>TemplateSpec \| undefined</code> | Chat template specification |
| <code>inferParams</code> | <code>InferenceParams \| undefined</code> | Default inference parameters |
| <code>models</code> | <code>Array\<string\> \| undefined</code> | Available model alternatives |
| <code>shots</code> | <code>Array\<HistoryTurn\> \| undefined</code> | Example conversation turns |
| <code>variables</code> | <code>AgentVariables \| undefined</code> | Required/optional input variables |
| <code>tools</code> | <code>Array\<ToolSpec\> \| undefined</code> | Inline tool definitions |
| <code>toolsList</code> | <code>Array\<string\> \| undefined</code> | References to registered tools |
| <code>mcp</code> | <code>McpServerSpec \| undefined</code> | MCP server specification |
| <code>skills</code> | <code>Array\<string\> \| undefined</code> | Associated skill names |
| <code>workflow</code> | <code>AgentWorkflow \| undefined</code> | Pre/post workflow steps |

### AgentParams

Parameters required to construct an <code>Agent</code> instance. Extends all callbacks.

```typescript
interface AgentParams extends AllCallbacks {
    name?: string;
    lm: LmProvider;
}
```

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| <code>name</code> | <code>string \| undefined</code> | Optional agent name identifier |
| <code>lm</code> | <code>LmProvider</code> | Language model provider (required) |

### AgentVariables

Definition of required and optional variables for an agent.

```typescript
interface AgentVariables {
    required?: Record<string, AgentVariableDef>;
    optional?: Record<string, AgentOptionalVariableDef>;
}
```

```typescript
interface AgentVariableDef {
    type: string | Array<string>;
    description: string;
}

interface AgentOptionalVariableDef extends AgentVariableDef {
    default?: any;
}

interface UserAgentVariables extends AgentVariables {
    values: {
        required: Record<string, string>;
        optional: Record<string, string>;
    };
}
```

### TemplateSpec

Template specification for controlling chat message formatting.

```typescript
interface TemplateSpec {
    system?: string;
    stop?: Array<string>;
    assistant?: string;
}
```

### AgentState

Reactive state management structure for an agent.

```typescript
interface AgentState {
    isReady: boolean;
    isProcessingPrompt: boolean;
    isLoadingModel: boolean;
    onReady: Promise<boolean>;
    promptProcessingProgress: PromptProcessingInProgressStats;
    hasConfig: boolean;
    uihistory: Array<UiHistoryTurn>;
    history: Array<HistoryTurn>;
    models: Record<string, Record<string, ModelInfo>>;
    agentsSettings: Record<string, AgentSettings>;
    backends: Record<string, InferenceBackend>;
    currentFeature: { name: string; type: string };
    currentWorkspace: Workspace;
    currentModel: ModelInfo;
    workspaces: Record<string, Workspace>;
    settings: Record<string, any>;
    samplingPresets: Record<string, SamplingPreset>;
}
```

### AgentWorkflow

Optional workflow steps to run before/after agent inference.

```typescript
interface AgentWorkflow {
    before?: Array<Record<string, string>>;
    after?: Array<Record<string, string>>;
}
```

## Tool Interfaces

### ToolSpec

Unified tool specification with an executable function. Extends <code>ToolDefSpec</code>.

```typescript
interface ToolSpec extends ToolDefSpec {
    type: string;
    parallelCalls: boolean;
    execute: <O = any>(
        args: { [key: string]: any } & { toolOptions?: AgentInferenceOptions } | undefined
    ) => Promise<O>;
    canRun?: (tool: ToolCallSpec) => Promise<boolean>;
}
```

### ToolDefSpec

Tool declaration format — name, description, and argument schema.

```typescript
interface ToolDefSpec {
    name: string;
    description: string;
    arguments: {
        [key: string]: {
            description: string;
            type?: string;
            required?: boolean;
        };
    };
}
```

### ToolCallSpec

Specification for an active tool call during inference.

```typescript
interface ToolCallSpec {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    arguments?: {
        [key: string]: string;
    };
}
```

### ToolTurn

A tool call paired with its response within a conversation turn.

```typescript
interface ToolTurn {
    call: ToolCallSpec;
    response: any;
    from: string;
    type: string;
}
```

## Inference Interfaces

### InferenceParams

Sampling parameters for an inference request.

```typescript
interface InferenceParams {
    stream?: boolean;
    max_tokens?: number;
    top_k?: number;
    top_p?: number;
    min_p?: number;
    temperature?: number;
    repeat_penalty?: number;
    presence_penalty?: number;
    frequency_penalty?: number;
    logit_bias?: Array<Array<number | false>>;
    seed?: number;
    tfs?: number;
    stop?: Array<string>;
    grammar?: string;
    tsGrammar?: string;
    schema?: Record<string, any>;
    images?: Array<string>;
    chat_template_kwargs?: Record<string, any>;
    extra?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

### InferenceOptions

Options for an inference request.

```typescript
interface InferenceOptions {
    debug?: boolean;
    verbose?: boolean;
    model?: string;
    backend?: string;
    tools?: Array<ToolSpec>;
    history?: Array<HistoryTurn>;
    system?: string;
    assistant?: string;
    isToolsRouter?: boolean;
    isToolCall?: boolean;
    propagateModel?: boolean;
    propagateInferParams?: boolean;
    variables?: Record<string, any>;
    params?: InferenceParams;
    verbosity?: VerbosityOptions;
}
```

### AgentInferenceOptions

Agent-level inference options extending <code>InferenceOptions</code> with agent-specific callbacks.

```typescript
interface AgentInferenceOptions extends InferenceOptions, AllCallbacks {
    baseDir?: string;
    isChatMode?: boolean;
    showTokens?: boolean;
    nocli?: boolean;
    backend?: string;
    variables?: Record<string, any>;
    mcpArgs?: Array<string>;
    confirmToolUsage?: (tool: ToolCallSpec, from: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    abort?: AbortController;
}
```

### ClientInferenceOptions

Client-side inference options extending <code>InferenceOptions</code> with callbacks.

```typescript
interface ClientInferenceOptions extends InferenceOptions, InferenceCallbacks {
    agentName?: string;
}
```

### InferenceResult

Result returned after an inference request completes.

```typescript
interface InferenceResult {
    text: string;
    thinkingText: string;
    stats: PerformanceMetrics;
    toolCalls?: Array<ToolCallSpec>;
}
```

### LmProvider

Language model provider interface — the core abstraction for inference backends.

```typescript
interface LmProvider extends InferenceCallbacks {
    name: string;
    api: ReturnType<typeof useApi>;
    serverUrl: string;
    apiKey: string;
    model: string;
    models: Array<ModelInfo>;
    abortController: AbortController;
    tools: Record<string, ToolSpec>;
    modelInfo: () => Promise<ModelInfo>;
    modelsInfo: () => Promise<Array<ModelInfo>>;
    loadModel: (
        name: string,
        ctx?: number,
        urls?: string | string[],
        onLoadProgress?: OnLoadProgress
    ) => Promise<void>;
    unloadModel: (name: string) => Promise<void>;
    tokenize(text: string): Promise<Array<number>>;
    detokenize(tokens: Array<number>): Promise<string>;
    infer: (prompt: string, options?: InferenceOptions) => Promise<InferenceResult>;
    abort: () => Promise<void>;
    defaults?: LmDefaults;
}
```

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| <code>name</code> | <code>string</code> | Provider identifier (e.g., <code>"openai"</code>, <code>"llamacpp"</code>) |
| <code>api</code> | <code>ReturnType\<typeof useApi\></code> | HTTP API utility from restmix |
| <code>serverUrl</code> | <code>string</code> | Backend endpoint URL |
| <code>apiKey</code> | <code>string</code> | Authentication key |
| <code>model</code> | <code>string</code> | Currently active model name |
| <code>models</code> | <code>Array\<ModelInfo\></code> | Available models on the backend |
| <code>loadModel</code> | <code>(...) => Promise\<void\></code> | Load a model into memory |
| <code>unloadModel</code> | <code>(name: string) => Promise\<void\></code> | Unload a model |
| <code>infer</code> | <code>(prompt, options?) => Promise\<InferenceResult\></code> | Run inference on a prompt |
| <code>abort</code> | <code>() => Promise\<void\></code> | Cancel a running inference |
| <code>tokenize</code> / <code>detokenize</code> | <code>(...) => Promise\<...></code> | Token conversion utilities |

### LmProviderParams

Parameters for creating an LM provider instance.

```typescript
interface LmProviderParams extends InferenceCallbacks {
    name: string;
    serverUrl: string;
    apiKey?: string;
    defaults?: LmDefaults;
}
```

### LmDefaults

Default parameters for an LM provider.

```typescript
interface LmDefaults {
    model?: string;
    inferenceParams?: InferenceParams;
}
```

## Callback Interfaces

### InferenceCallbacks

Callbacks fired during inference events (token streaming, errors, tool calls).

```typescript
interface InferenceCallbacks {
    onStartThinking?: (from: string) => void;
    onEndThinking?: (from: string) => void;
    onToken?: (t: string, from: string) => void;
    onThinkingToken?: (t: string, from: string) => void;
    onToolCallToken?: (t: string, from: string) => void;
    onStartEmit?: (data: PromptProcessingInProgressStats, from: string) => void;
    onEndEmit?: (result: InferenceResult, from: string) => void;
    onError?: (err: any, from: string) => void;
    onToolCallInProgress?: (tc: Array<ToolCallSpec>, from: string) => void;
    onPromptProcessingProgress?: (progress: PromptProcessingInProgressStats, from: string) => void;
}
```

### AgentCallbacks

Callbacks fired during agent interaction events (tool calls, turns, responses).

```typescript
interface AgentCallbacks {
    onToolCall?: (tc: ToolCallSpec, type: string, from: string) => void;
    onToolCallEnd?: (tc: ToolCallSpec, tr: any, type: string, from: string) => void;
    onToolsTurnStart?: (tc: Array<ToolCallSpec>, from: string) => void;
    onToolsTurnEnd?: (tt: Array<ToolTurn>, from: string) => void;
    onTurnStart?: (from: string) => void;
    onTurnEnd?: (ht: HistoryTurn, from: string) => void;
    onAssistant?: (txt: string, from: string) => void;
    onThink?: (txt: string, from: string) => void;
}
```

### AllCallbacks

Combined interface extending both <code>InferenceCallbacks</code> and <code>AgentCallbacks</code>.

```typescript
interface AllCallbacks extends InferenceCallbacks, AgentCallbacks { }
```

## History Interfaces

### HistoryTurn

A single conversation turn containing user input, assistant output, tools, and optional images.

```typescript
interface HistoryTurn {
    user?: string;
    assistant?: string;
    think?: string;
    images?: Array<ImgData>;
    tools?: Array<ToolTurn>;
    stats?: InferenceStats;
    prefillStats?: PromptProcessingInProgressStats;
}
```

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| <code>user</code> | <code>string \| undefined</code> | User message content |
| <code>assistant</code> | <code>string \| undefined</code> | Assistant response text |
| <code>think</code> | <code>string \| undefined</code> | Model thinking/reasoning content |
| <code>images</code> | <code>Array\<ImgData\> \| undefined</code> | Attached image data (multimodal) |
| <code>tools</code> | <code>Array\<ToolTurn\> \| undefined</code> | Tool calls made in this turn |
| <code>stats</code> | <code>InferenceStats \| undefined</code> | Inference performance metrics |
| <code>prefillStats</code> | <code>PromptProcessingInProgressStats \| undefined</code> | Prompt processing progress |

### UiHistoryTurn

UI-enriched history turn with metadata for rendering.

```typescript
interface UiHistoryTurn extends HistoryTurn {
    from: string;
    type: UiHistoryTurnType;
    state: UiHistoryTurnState;
    agentTurn: number;
}
```

### ImgData

Image data attached to a message.

```typescript
interface ImgData {
    id: number;
    data: string;
}
```

### UiHistoryTurnState

UI rendering state for a history turn.

```typescript
interface UiHistoryTurnState {
    showThinking: boolean;
    showToolResponses: Array<string>;
    confirmRestartAtTurn: number | null;
    confirmToolCalls: Record<string, {
        resolve: (value: boolean) => void;
        reject: (reason?: any) => void;
    }>;
}
```

### UiHistoryTurnType

Union type for UI turn classification.

```typescript
type UiHistoryTurnType = "unknown" | "user" | "assistant" | "think" | "tools";
```

## Model Interfaces

### ModelInfo

Metadata about an available model.

```typescript
interface ModelInfo {
    id: string;
    status: string;
    ctx: number;
    hasVision: boolean;
}
```

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| <code>id</code> | <code>string</code> | Unique model identifier |
| <code>status</code> | <code>string</code> | Current model status string |
| <code>ctx</code> | <code>number</code> | Context window size in tokens |
| <code>hasVision</code> | <code>boolean</code> | Whether the model supports image input |

### ModelTemplate

Template definition for a model variant.

```typescript
interface ModelTemplate {
    name: string;
    ctx?: number;
}
```

### ModelState

Server-side model state summary.

```typescript
interface ModelState {
    models: Record<string, ModelTemplate>;
    isModelLoaded: boolean;
    loadedModel: string;
    ctx?: number;
}
```

### ModelStatus

Discriminated union of model lifecycle states.

```typescript
type ModelStatus = ModelStatusUnloaded | ModelStatusLoading | ModelStatusFailed | ModelStatusLoaded;

interface ModelStatusUnloaded { value: "unloaded" }
interface ModelStatusLoading { value: "loading"; args: string[] }
interface ModelStatusFailed { value: "failed"; args: string[]; failed: true; exit_code: number }
interface ModelStatusLoaded { value: "loaded"; args: string[] }
```

### ModelData

Full model data including file path and status.

```typescript
interface ModelData {
    id: string;
    in_cache: boolean;
    path: string;
    status: ModelStatus;
}
```

### ModelApiResponse

API response wrapping an array of <code>ModelData</code>.

```typescript
interface ModelApiResponse {
    data: ModelData[];
}
```

## WebSocket Protocol Types

### WsClientMsg

Client-to-server message structure sent over the WebSocket connection.

```typescript
interface WsClientMsg {
    command: string;
    type: WsClientMsgType;
    feature?: FeatureType;
    payload?: any;
    options?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

### WsRawClientMsg

Raw WebSocket client message before parsing.

```typescript
interface WsRawClientMsg {
    type: WsClientMsgType;
    msg: string;
}
```

### WsRawServerMsg

Raw WebSocket server message before parsing.

```typescript
interface WsRawServerMsg {
    type: WsServerMsgType;
    from: string;
    msg: string;
}
```

### StreamedMessage

Real-time streamed update structure used by the client to render tokens and events.

```typescript
interface StreamedMessage {
    content: string;
    type: MsgType;
    num: number;
    data?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

### WsServerMsgType

Union of all 22 server-to-client message types streamed over <code>/ws</code>.

```typescript
type WsServerMsgType =
    | 'error'
    | 'startemit'
    | 'token'
    | 'thinkingtoken'
    | 'turnstart'
    | 'turnend'
    | 'assistant'
    | 'thinkingstart'
    | 'thinkingend'
    | 'toolcallinprogress'
    | 'promptprocessingprogress'
    | 'toolcalltoken'
    | 'toolsturnstart'
    | 'toolsturnend'
    | 'toolcall'
    | 'toolcallend'
    | 'toolcallconfirm'
    | 'finalresult'
    | "think"
    | 'endemit';
```

### WsClientMsgType

Union of client message types.

```typescript
type WsClientMsgType = "command" | "system";
```

### MsgType

General message type discriminator.

```typescript
type MsgType = "token" | "system" | "error";
```

### ServerParams

Parameters for connecting to the server via WebSocket. Extends <code>AllCallbacks</code>.

```typescript
interface ServerParams extends AllCallbacks {
    url?: string;
    isVerbose?: boolean;
    defaultInferenceParams?: InferenceParams;
    onConfirmToolUsage?: (tool: ToolCallSpec) => Promise<boolean>;
}
```

## Configuration Types

### ConfigFile

Application configuration structure loaded from the config file.

```typescript
interface ConfigFile {
    promptfile?: string;
    datadir?: string;
    features?: Array<string>;
    plugins?: Array<string>;
    backends?: BackendEntries;
    agents?: Record<string, AgentSettings>;
    apps?: Record<string, string>;
    workspaces?: Record<string, string>;
}
```

### InferenceBackend

Configuration for an inference backend.

```typescript
interface InferenceBackend extends ConfInferenceBackend {
    name: string;
    isDefault?: boolean;
}

interface ConfInferenceBackend {
    type?: LmProviderType;
    url: string;
    apiKey?: string;
}

type BackendEntries = {
    default: string;
    [key: string]: ConfInferenceBackend | string;
};
```

### LmProviderType

Supported LM provider types.

```typescript
type LmProviderType = "llamacpp" | "openai" | "browser";
```

## Core Feature Types

### FeatureSpec

Metadata for a discovered feature (agent, action, workflow, skill, etc.).

```typescript
interface FeatureSpec {
    id?: number;
    name: string;
    path: string;
    ext: FeatureExtension;
    variables?: AgentVariables | Record<string, any>;
    type?: string;
    category?: string;
}
```

### Features

Typed collection of all discovered features by kind.

```typescript
interface Features {
    agent: Array<{ name: string; path: string; ext: AgentExtension }>;
    cmd: Array<{
        name: string; path: string; ext: CmdExtension;
        variables?: { name: string; options?: Array<Array<string> | string>; description: string };
    }>;
    action: Array<{ name: string; path: string; ext: ActionExtension }>;
    workflow: Array<{ name: string; path: string; ext: WorkflowExtension }>;
    adaptater: Array<{ name: string; path: string; ext: AdaptaterExtension }>;
    skill: Array<{ name: string; path: string; ext: SkillExtension; variables?: Record<string, any> }>;
}
```

### Feature Type Aliases

```typescript
type FeatureType = "agent" | "action" | "cmd" | "workflow" | "adaptater" | "skill";
type ToolType = "agent" | "action" | "cmd" | "workflow";
type AliasType = "agent" | "action" | "workflow";

type AgentExtension = "yml";
type ActionExtension = "js" | "mjs" | "py" | "yml";
type WorkflowExtension = "yml";
type AdaptaterExtension = "js";
type CmdExtension = "js";
type SkillExtension = "md";
type FeatureExtension = AgentExtension | CmdExtension | ActionExtension | WorkflowExtension | SkillExtension;

type InputMode = "manual" | "promptfile" | "clipboard";
type OutputMode = "txt" | "clipboard";
type RunMode = "cli" | "cmd";
type FormatMode = "text" | "markdown";

type FeatureExecutor<I = any, O = any> = (
    params: I,
    options: Record<string, any>
) => Promise<O>;
```

### WorkflowStep

A single step in a workflow pipeline.

```typescript
interface WorkflowStep {
    name: string;
    type: string;
}
```

### McpServerSpec

MCP (Model Context Protocol) server specification.

```typescript
interface McpServerSpec {
    command: string;

}

interface McpServerTool {
    name: string;
    description: string;
    inputSchema: {
        type: string;
        properties: Record<string, { type: string; description: string }>;
        required: string[];
    };
}
```

### Settings

Runtime settings for the CLI.

```typescript
interface Settings {
    name: string;
    inputmode: InputMode;
    outputmode: OutputMode;
    runmode: RunMode;
    formatmode: FormatMode;
    ischatMode: boolean;
    isdebug: boolean;
    isverbose: boolean;
    promptfile: string;
}
```

### DbModelDef

Database model definition.

```typescript
interface DbModelDef {
    id?: number;
    name: string;
    shortname: string;
    data: Record<string, any>;
}
```

### UserCmdDef

User-defined CLI command.

```typescript
interface UserCmdDef {
    name: string;
    description: string;
    run: (args: any, options: Record<string, any>) => Promise<any>;
    options?: Array<Array<string> | string>;
}
```

### ClientFeaturesService

Service interface for client-side feature execution.

```typescript
interface ClientFeaturesService {
    isReady: Ref<boolean>;

    variables: Reactive<UserAgentVariables>;
    mcp: Reactive<{ servers: Record<string, any> }>;
    loadModels: (backend: string) => Promise<Record<string, ModelInfo>>;

    load: (name: string, isAgent?: boolean) => Promise<void>;
    loadWorkflow: (name: string) => Promise<Record<string, any>>;
    loadBackends: () => Promise<Record<string, any>>;
    setBackend: (name: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    executeAgent: (prompt: string, opts?: ClientFeaturesOptions) => Promise<void>;
    executeAgentSync: (prompt: string, opts?: ClientFeaturesOptions) => Promise<void>;
    executeWorkflow: (name: string, payload: any, options?: ClientFeaturesOptions) => Promise<void>;
    executeWorkflowSync: (name: string, payload: any, options?: ClientFeaturesOptions) => Promise<void>;
    cancel: () => Promise<void>;
    getTools: (tools: Array<string>) => Promise<Array<{ def: ToolDefSpec; type: string }>>;
    checkState: () => Promise<{ found: boolean; config: ConfigFile }>;
    loadWorkspaces: () => Promise<Array<Workspace>>;
    loadSettings: () => Promise<Record<string, any>>;
    loadSamplingPresets: () => Promise<Record<string, SamplingPreset>>;
}
```

### ClientFeaturesOptions

Client feature execution options.

```typescript
interface ClientFeaturesOptions extends AgentInferenceOptions {
    backend?: string;
    variables?: Record<string, any>;
    nohistory?: boolean;
}
```

### SamplingPreset

Named sampling preset stored in the database.

```typescript
interface SamplingPreset {
    name: string;
    model?: string;
    max_tokens?: number;
    top_k?: number;
    top_p?: number;
    min_p?: number;
    temperature?: number;
    repeat_penalty?: number;
    presence_penalty?: number;
    frequency_penalty?: number;
    backend?: string;
    chat_template_kwargs?: Record<string, any>;
    props?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

### Load Progress Types

```typescript
interface OnLoadProgressBasic {
    total: number;
    loaded: number;
}

interface OnLoadProgressFull extends OnLoadProgressBasic {
    percent: number;
}

type OnLoadProgress = (data: OnLoadProgressFull) => void;
type BasicOnLoadProgress = (data: OnLoadProgressBasic) => void;
```
